title: Automation Flight Recorder: see what caused what
audience: Developers inheriting a partially completed automation run who need causal evidence without raw machine state.
promise: Record one declared workflow as a bounded parent/child trace, redact output, preserve omissions and partial failure, and make rerun eligibility explicit.
story: A declared quality workflow records each child under one parent identity.
A passing trace preserves timing-era output boundaries, hashes, omissions, and mutation declarations.
A failed child leaves earlier work intact and marks later work not-run.
Rerun eligibility is guidance to review, not implicit permission to replay.
verified_locally: Passing parent/child trace with redacted output and named omissions.
Failed child preserves siblings and marks later work not-run.
Source tests, lint, and package checks pass, including timeout-to-cancelled coverage.
Current dev pass, failure, cancellation, and inspect flows were rerun headlessly.
1600×900 PNG/SVG preview was regenerated and visually reviewed.
open_gates: Connect one real Workflow Gateboard action and preserve cross-tool parent identity.
Expand cancellation, missing-artifact, and stale-rerun scenario receipts.
Connect the local case to a hosted no-auth URL and verify it.
Record external GitHub, portfolio, and Handshake readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves a local W3 trace slice; it does not claim Gateboard integration, complete recovery coverage, permission to rerun, hosting, or publication.
